card.line: Media was a land and kingdom east of Assyria, later joined with Persia, whose kings and laws appear in the stories of Ezra, Esther, Isaiah, and Daniel.

moments.title: Cyrus's decree found
moments.text: King Darius ordered a search of the archives. A scroll was found in the fortress of Ecbatana, in the province of Media. It recorded Cyrus's decree that the house of God in Jerusalem be rebuilt.

moments.title: Law that cannot change
moments.text: Xerxes' advisors, the seven princes of Persia and Media, talked about Queen Vashti. Memucan asked for a decree recorded in the laws of Persia and Media so that it could not be repealed.

moments.title: Media called to attack
moments.text: In a dire vision, Isaiah heard a call for Elam and Media to lay siege. God said He would put an end to the groaning.

moments.title: The two-horned ram
moments.text: Daniel was told that the two-horned ram in his vision represents the kings of Media and Persia.
